review: Reviewed Lin's round-9 request (root propagation and tending) and the accepted world-16 develop review (learning 3). The review asks the handoff to author species parameters for root propagation: viable propagules, establishment duration, growth rate, resource demands and finite yield. Inspection of the implementation shows no such biology: wild sources regrow their own finite stock, and a gathered root unit has only nutrition, toxicity and decay; no rule makes a root unit establish, grow or yield. Under this run's operating rule the developer does not author new physical or biological rules that the world does not already contain, so biological support remains unresolved. Following the review's own instruction for that case, the trial is preserved as unresolved with an explicit blocker rather than reported as failure or shipped as growth: no new package, mode or rule is installed. Lin is assigned the existing general cultivate-plant operation (learning 3, equal to the reviewed duration), whose contract and plot state already state that there is no propagation, growth, harvest or replenishment rule and that viability is unverified; planting, baseline-probe inspection, refused tending and planter-only removal stay exactly as implemented in cultivate-plant@1. Tending remains unavailable because no competing cover or water transfer is represented. Blocker recorded for the human: a propagation model would need explicit, separately decided biological parameters; none are invented here. No source, budget, goal or experiment policy changes; no reward is added.
